causalIntervention.description: The compiler replaces repeated slide agenda, fact-ledger lead, and discussion shells with lesson-specific evidence decisions, source boundaries, criteria, counterevidence, and revision consequences. It also rejects instruction-shaped labels before they become visible headings.

visibleUnitMeasurement.claimBoundary: The visible-unit metric measures learner-visible repetition in comparable artifact windows. It does not replace the frozen quality score, grade factual correctness, or certify teachability.

The AI judge found shared pre-existing weaknesses in some no-assignment placeholders, explicit discussion labeling, one Mandarin final-task alignment, and sparse source trails. The candidate did not regress these, but they remain future quality targets.
